title: Housing Affordability: Jeremiah Babe Calls for a Crash
description:
Original video author: jeremiah babe. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Housing affordability drives jeremiah babe’s argument that America needs an asset-price reset. This recap first covers his warnings about oil-driven inflation, federal debt and an AI-stock selloff, plus his preference for gold. Next come his cited estimate of roughly $2,000 per household in Iran-war costs and his argument for repairing California dams instead of funding war. Finally, he cites Redfin’s claim that home sellers outnumber buyers by 63% and calls for higher rates and lower asset prices.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#jeremiahbabe #jeremiahbabehousingcrash #housingaffordability #MentalHealth #Wellness
music_mood: light rhythmic instrumental groove, warm keys, crisp soft percussion, curious and approachable, steady moderate energy, no ominous tension, no sirens or trailer impacts
hook: Jeremiah Babe says America needs a crash to make assets affordable.
reporter_prompt: A middle-aged American male reporter wearing a navy blazer stands on a public sidewalk beside an American suburban house visibly listed for sale, with a real estate yard sign and additional detached homes behind him. Independent commentator, not Jeremiah Babe and not an impersonation. Soft afternoon daylight, warm and thoughtful delivery, restrained camera push-in, horizontal composition. Add typography only in postproduction. Use charcoal panels, orange emphasis, white bold condensed headings,
